summary: The broad market is recovering even though the Nifty is flat. Advancers outnumber decliners almost 3:1, and the Sensex is edging higher on IT buying.

detail.leaders: IT (TCS top Sensex gainer), PSU banks, Oil & Gas, Chemicals; broader markets
detail.laggards: Healthcare (Dr Reddy's, Max Healthcare); BSE after its Nifty 50 debut
detail.tone: Firmer than 09:30: at 10:00 the Sensex was up 166.67 (+0.23%) at 72,695.74 and the Nifty flat at 22,723.10 (−6.90). NSE breadth is strong at 1,720 up vs 639 down.
